items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: This is what Diz did to Miles.

ctx.x: Yeah. And Slide went over and said, “guys, you know, don’t do this, because it’s making you look bad.” And Slide just said — you will stay — I wanted to get off the stage and he said, “you will stand there and you will play because this is the tradition. This is what’s been done. This is what Diz did to Miles. This is what has been done to people over the years as long as jazz has been an art form.” So he said just to stay with it and do it, and to do the best you can, and I did okay. And you know, “Just Friends”…
Yeah. Thank God you got started when you were five with your father doing that.
